title: ERSkill: Evolving for Skill-Guided Adaptive Memory Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.12720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory for persistent interactions, the retrieval mechanisms governing this memory are rarely treated as evolvable components. This static approach limits performance on heterogeneous memory queries, which often demand diverse evidence construction strategies. To address this, we introduce \textbf{ERSkill}, a retrieval-centric framework for self-evolving, skill-guided memory access. ERSkill compiles interaction histories into a structured memory store and represents retrieval behaviors as executable skills composed of fundamental primitives. At inference time, a trained router dynamically matches each query to the optimal skill to construct tailored evidence for answer generation. translated_title: ERSkill：面向技能引导的自适应记忆检索的进化方法
translated_abstract: 论文编号：arXiv:2608.12720v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：虽然大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越依赖长期记忆进行持久交互，但控制这种记忆的检索机制很少被视为可进化的组件。这种静态方法限制了其在异构记忆查询上的性能，这些查询通常需要多样化的证据构建策略。为解决这一问题，我们引入了\textbf{ERSkill}，一种以检索为中心的框架，用于自我进化的、技能引导的记忆访问。ERSkill将交互历史编译成结构化的记忆存储，并将检索行为表示为由基本原语组成的可执行技能。在推理时，一个训练过的路由器动态地将每个查询匹配到最优技能，以构建针对性的证据用于答案生成。为了实现持续改进，ERSkill在训练过程中共同进化技能集和路由器。它采用经验树来高效记录探索过的检索路径，以及...
tldr: ERSkill提出了一种将记忆检索视为可进化技能的系统，通过动态路由和技能集与路由器的协同进化，显著提升了LLM代理在异构查询下的自适应记忆访问能力。
en_tdlr: ERSkill proposes a retrieval-centric framework that treats memory retrieval as evolvable skills, using dynamic routing and co-evolution of skills and router to enhance adaptive memory access for LLM agents under heterogeneous queries.
